violation_type.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Adaptive equipment (26 TAC §746.2202(2))
violation_type.short_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Adaptive equipment
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated with reference to a report and was determined to be deficient. Caregivers did not utilize as recommended adaptive equipment that was provided to the center for a child's use.

finding_variants.text: This standard was evaluated with reference to a report and was determined to be deficient. Caregivers did not utilize as recommended adaptive equipment that was provided to the center for a child's use.

Adaptive equipment provided to the operation for therapeutic reasons, was used in an inappropriate manner with two children and was not used as recommended when the equipment was used to confine them to their chairs.
